turn_text: Welcome into the Play Politics podcast on your host Tyler Page. My guest today is Congressman Mia Love. Thank you so much for joining me.
It's great to be in your office.
No problem. Excited to be here.
Well, I'm curious. This is year one. You're coming to just about a year now here in DC. What's it like? What's the transition been like?

Well, it's been really fast paced. That's for sure. It's kind of crazy how things move really quickly in the house compared to the Senate. You go over the Senate's office and things just kind of go slow. People walk slower. But a lot of things are happening here. And you have to learn very quickly and adjust very quickly and be able to have a get that process down in a very short time period.
I feel like you've had some time on the national stage, but Congress is still pretty new. What's been the biggest surprise?

Well, I think the biggest surprise would be, and I guess it's a bigger surprise than I thought. is the amount to how complicated and big Washington is. It's very difficult to navigate through, and it shouldn't be that way. When you have a big government, centralized government system like this, that was never meant to be so centralized, that people end up losing their ability to understand what's going on, to be able to make their voices heard in Washington. And it's been my mission to do everything I can to get the decision-making as close to people as possible. simplify Washington here, make Washington smaller so that people can be bigger.
